description: This Java class implements a FreeMarker template transformation for generating alternative URLs for content items within the Apache OFBiz framework. It retrieves content-related data from entities, constructs URLs based on content configuration, and integrates with HTTP request/response objects.

classes.name: OfbizContentAltUrlTransforms
classes.description: Implements a FreeMarker template transformation to generate alternative URLs for content items in OFBiz, utilizing request/response data, entity queries, and URL encoding.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the map of template arguments, handling different object types like SimpleScalar, SimpleNumber, and BeanModel.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a custom Writer that captures output and, upon closing, generates a URL based on content ID and view parameters.

methods.name: makeContentAltUrl
methods.description: Constructs an alternative URL for content based on associated data, falling back to default URL construction if no association is found.

methods.name: makeContentUrl
methods.description: Builds a standard content URL with context path, view, and content ID parameters.
